character: Authentic Haute-Savoie family resort on a sunny plateau. Part of Grand Massif (265km). Aquacîme wellness centre — 1,500m², heated outdoor pool (30° in winter). Rail toboggan through spruce forest. Corbalanche freeride area. Family-friendly, authentic village charm.
description: Les Carroz is a pioneer of winter sports in the Grand Massif, retaining its authentic village soul on a sunny plateau at 1,140m. Haute-Savoie architecture of cosy chalets. Part of the 265km Grand Massif area (linked to Flaine, Samoëns, Morillon, Sixt). The Aquacîme spa complex (1,500m²) features a large heated outdoor pool at 30° in winter. Oasis Cool Zone has boardercross, snowpark, slalom. Corbalanche freeride area accessible from new Tête des Saix chairlift. Rail toboggan — unique sledging on rails through spruce forest from Kédeuze gondola. Bike Park with 7 downhill runs (14km). Easy access from A40 motorway (Cluses exit).

non_ski_activities.aquacime: 1,500m² wellness centre with large heated outdoor pool (30° in winter). Mountain views. Relaxation area.
non_ski_activities.rail_toboggan: Unique rail toboggan — sledging on rails through spruce forest. From Kédeuze gondola. Year-round attraction.
non_ski_activities.oasis_cool_zone: Boardercross, snowpark, slalom. Free for all levels. Video zone to film your exploits.
non_ski_activities.corbalanche_freeride: Freeride area accessible from new Tête des Saix chairlift.
non_ski_activities.bike_park: 7 downhill runs, 14km total. Summer mountain biking.
non_ski_activities.dog_sledding: Musher experience — each person their own sled and dog team.
non_ski_activities.ice_activities: Ice skating, ice climbing (cascades and goulottes).
non_ski_activities.night_activities: Night snowshoeing, ice rink, bowling, cinema, arcade games.
non_ski_activities.other: Paragliding, canyoning, mountain cart, ski touring, cross-country skiing, snowshoeing, mini-golf, golf at 1,900m.

honest_drawbacks: Lower altitude base (1,140m) — snow variable at village level
Requires lifts for full Grand Massif access
